svg.title: Heartbeat viewport ownership, source-bound parity, duplicate-owner, pulse-identity, and persisted-poll fail-closed scars
svg.desc: A non-raster warm-wall diagram showing visible heartbeat contact at capture, newer direct keyboard navigation superseding stale selection ownership, existing-owner focus-scope wiring, parser/direct candidate bound parity, fail-closed duplicate semantic ownership, root pulse identity bound parity, and persisted-poll contact truth: empty storage before first contact is waiting, empty storage after visible contact is a preserved wound, and positive wall-clock timestamp churn alone does not earn repeated semantic projection. Android runtime behavior and TalkBack accessibility focus remain unproven.
svg.text: WARM WALL / PERSISTENT SELECTION ≠ PERMANENT OWNER
OWNER FOCUS-SCOPE SOURCE WIRED • RUNTIME UNPROVEN • TALKBACK UNCLAIMED • PHONE UNTOUCHED
CAPTURE
● SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED A
Capture anchor + keyboard baseline + viewport offset.
SHOVEL
newer interaction wins
BEFORE RESTORE
● SELECTED A
□ FOCUSED B
selection persists; newer keyboard navigation kills A ticket
EXISTING OWNER / EXPLICIT SCOPE
Stable in-place refresh → mutation may destroy focus = NO. Empty child focus gets no rebuild costume.
Structural or drift fallback rebuild → may destroy focus = YES; root direct-focus scope is checked before restore.
Different heartbeat focus or any non-heartbeat direct focus → stale ticket dies. TalkBack remains separate evidence.
CAPTURE BASELINE + ACTUAL MUTATION + ROOT FOCUS SCOPE
No geometry-only Christmas twitch. Source wiring ≠ Android execution. Direct keyboard focus ≠ TalkBack focus.
SOURCE BOUNDS / PARSER = DIRECT TYPED GATE
Oversized direct Candidate → BLOCKED · last-good contact held · motion forbidden · no truncation costume.
ONE MATERIAL ID = ONE OWNER
regnet + REGNET material aliases → REJECTED · no first-wins Button · last-good contact held · no motion.
ROOT PULSE ID / ONE BOUND
parser = direct scene = pre-parser diagnostic · max+1 → REJECTED · attempted ID suppressed · contact held · no motion.
PERSISTED POLL / WAITING ≠ CONTACT LOST
empty before first contact → WAITING · empty after contact → WOUND ONCE · positive timestamp churn alone → NO SEMANTIC WORK
Poll policy source exists. Existing-owner consumption remains unproven. Runtime/test proof stays separate. No phone/P0 surface consumed.
